note: GraphRAG evaluation set. Written from the seeded data's semantics (ai/knowledge/*.json, Backend/prisma/seed.ts) BEFORE any result was computed. Each question is asked twice through the real answer pipeline with the model switched off: BASELINE = text retrieval only (BM25 [+pgvector], agent and graph off, as before the graph work) and GRAPHRAG = entity resolution + Neo4j traversal + fused retrieval + judge history. A question passes when every string in expect.all appears (case-insensitive) in the evidence, claims or answer shown to the user and no string in expect.none does; 'unanswerable' passes when the answer is low-confidence, contains no observation and says the evidence is insufficient (or asks for clarification); 'refusal' passes on the named policy refusal. Users are the seeded accounts.
